objects.description: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) has utilized [WarzoneRAT](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0670) to remotely access a compromised system.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: Check Point Scattered Spider JUL 2025)
